prompt.project_info: Create an original cinematic neo-noir fashion portrait in a cold teal interrogation room, without reproducing a named film or public figure.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with long dark glossy waves, smoky cat-eye makeup, bold red lips, sleeveless white high-neck mini dress with secure coverage, white pointed heels and gold bracelet; seated in a black metal chair with legs naturally crossed, one arm on chair back, direct confident gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: Teal-blue tiled wall, concrete floor, solitary chair, 35mm anamorphic framing, cool shadows with warm skin highlights, subtle film grain.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Teal ambient room light, strong directional key from left, long shadows, controlled rim light, dramatic neo-noir mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm anamorphic lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, cinematic 8K photorealism, lifelike skin and fabric, no cigarette, text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic original neo-noir fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman seated in a black metal chair in a cold teal-blue tiled interrogation room, sleeveless white high-neck dress with secure coverage, white pointed heels, gold bracelet, long dark glossy waves, smoky cat-eye makeup, bold red lips, legs naturally crossed, one arm on chair back, direct confident gaze, teal ambient light, left-side directional key, 35mm anamorphic f/2.0, cinematic grain, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, seductive pose, cigarette, smoking, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, named film recreation, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: cold teal interrogation fashion reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve teal tiled room, chair, white dress, crossed-leg composition, noir light and direct gaze; replace public-figure or film-specific identity with a fictional adult.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep the original noir fashion atmosphere and outfit silhouette, but do not reproduce a named film, celebrity likeness, or smoking action.

changes: Removed named film and celebrity-lookalike direction, removed smoking, clarified adult fictional identity, and retained the nonsexual crossed-leg fashion pose.
policy_review.notes: Original neo-noir fashion concept retained safely.
